claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Estriol is a weak estrogen receptor agonist that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells through ER-mediated signaling; any modest antiproliferative effect would reflect weak, non-selective estrogenic/cytostatic activity rather than a potent cytotoxic mechanism.
